description: Search contacts with filters, sorting, and pagination.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

filters.description: Array of filter objects to narrow results (e.g. [{field:'email',operator:'eq',value:'test@example.com'}])

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

query.description: Search query string to match against contact fields

sort.description: Field name to sort results by

name: crm_search_contacts
